title: Reservoir South

canonical.text:
You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.

There is a path along the stream to the east or west, a steep pathway
climbing southwest along the edge of a chasm, and a path leading into a
canyon to the southeast.

prompt:
Create one complete static illustration of Reservoir South.

Viewpoint: Stand at the southern shore looking north across the long basin.

The scene establishes these features: You are in a long room, to the north of which was formerly a lake. However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream running through the center of the room. There is a path along the stream to the east or west, a steep pathway climbing southwest along the edge of a chasm, and a path leading into a canyon to the southeast.

Composition: Keep east/west streamside paths, southwest steep chasm route and southeast canyon route distinct; hold basin contours fixed across water levels.

Appearance of this illustration: The lowered reservoir is a wide stream through the exposed basin.

Lighting and color: Cool water reflection, gray-brown shoreline and low fill.

Shared world design: Massive plain concrete engineering, dark iron fittings, restrained green/red/blue/yellow controls; lock bank contours and dam silhouette across water states.

Style: Painterly adventure-game illustration recalling fine late-1980s and early-1990s computer artwork; natural proportions, restrained brushwork, readable silhouettes and broad tonal masses. Aim for roughly 256 visually significant colors, broad related color regions, controlled shading and clear dark/light separation. No exact RGB-count requirement, photographic color noise, excessive gradients or microtextures.

Keep this room camera, underlying architecture, terrain layout, light direction and palette consistent across its variants. Depict the complete scene, including the appearance stated above.

Landscape source composition near 4:3. Final scene is 256 by 159 pixels. Allow safe center cropping to 256:159, keeping essential subjects inside the central 82.8 percent of source height and away from the side boundaries. Use clear silhouettes and broad readable shapes at that final size.

Exclude game UI, borders, captions, labels, readable lettering, photographic detail, pixel grids and enlarged pixels. Do not add characters, significant props, openings or events beyond the established scene. Do not depict an action in progress or a before/after collage.
negative_prompt: No UI, borders, readable text, photorealism, pixel grid, invented props, extra exits or transient action events.
